observation_method: Read-only live Amazon.com page in the existing local Chrome US delivery context. No cart change or purchase.

selected_fan.variant: Standard beige/brown 12 V, 4-pin PWM, 80 mm; not the 5 V variant

availability.scope: Amazon.com US delivery context. This offer and price are not claimed for India or other delivery regions. The India-context in-app browser showed a separate imported third-party offer, not this manufacturer-sold offer.

popularity.limit: Changing listing-level signals, potentially pooled across variants; not evidence of worldwide sales leadership.

current_board_compatibility.rail: FAN_12V from VBUS_QUALIFIED; enabled while qualified PD is present, including TEC STOP
current_board_compatibility.operation: Plug factory cable directly into J_FAN without the Low-Noise Adaptor. No PWM input means full rated speed. Tach is not monitored.
current_board_compatibility.qualification_limit: Manufacturer ratings establish electrical compatibility; a separate peak startup/inrush current is not published for this model, and startup, rail overshoot and thermal performance have not been bench-tested. The published 0.08 A maximum is not represented as a measured startup bound. A hot-side heatsink is not selected by this fan record.
